data: Is the first plot presenting the information regarding the question?

The first plot is the top one in the compound figure. It represents the question portion of the interview sequence. The question is labeled as "English_J0104G-Argentina-Aquestion". The x-axis shows time in milliseconds, and the y-axis shows F0 (fundamental frequency). The lines represent different acoustic features: F0, [voice], glob mps, and local mps. The question is presented in the form of phonetic transcriptions at the bottom of the plot. Therefore, the first plot is indeed presenting the information regarding the question.
